name: Stock Available and Payment Succeeds (Happy Path)
description: VIP customer ordering 2 units of LAPTOP-X1 with OVERNIGHT delivery. Stock is verified (45 available). DMN sets Priority to Critical. Payment succeeds. Fulfilled.
expectedRoute: StartEvent_OrderReceived -> Task_ValidateAndCheckStock -> Gateway_StockAvailability (In Stock) -> Task_DetermineOrderPriority -> Gateway_HighValueCheck (Critical/High Value) -> Task_ManualOrderVerification [Approved] -> Task_ProcessPaymentGateway -> Gateway_PaymentOutcome (Success) -> Task_DispatchFulfilment -> EndEvent_Fulfilled

name: Stock Insufficient (Order Cannot Proceed)
description: Customer ordering 10 units of GPU-SERVER. Real-time inventory indicates 0 units in stock. Gateway routes directly to cancellation notice.
expectedRoute: StartEvent_OrderReceived -> Task_ValidateAndCheckStock -> Gateway_StockAvailability (Out of Stock) -> Task_NotifyOutOfStock -> EndEvent_OutOfStock

name: Payment Declined by Mock Service
description: Customer ordering 1 HEADSET-PRO ($180). Stock is available. DMN sets Priority to Standard. Payment gateway responds with DECLINED (Insufficient funds).
expectedRoute: StartEvent_OrderReceived -> Task_ValidateAndCheckStock -> Gateway_StockAvailability (In Stock) -> Task_DetermineOrderPriority -> Gateway_HighValueCheck (Standard) -> Task_ProcessPaymentGateway [DECLINED] -> Gateway_PaymentOutcome (Declined) -> Task_NotifyPaymentDeclined -> EndEvent_PaymentDeclined

name: High-Value Order Routed to Manual Review
description: New customer ordering 3 units of WORKSTATION-ULTRA ($6,600). Order exceeds $2,000 threshold. Routed to Tasklist User Task for fraud/operations verification.
expectedRoute: StartEvent_OrderReceived -> Task_ValidateAndCheckStock -> Gateway_StockAvailability (In Stock) -> Task_DetermineOrderPriority (High) -> Gateway_HighValueCheck (Manual Review) -> Task_ManualOrderVerification (Tasklist) [Approved] -> Task_ProcessPaymentGateway -> Task_DispatchFulfilment -> EndEvent_Fulfilled

name: Payment Service Fails and Recovers After Corrective Action
description: Simulates payment gateway timeout (504 Gateway Timeout) on token 'tok_gateway_timeout_simulate'. Zeebe incident raised in Operate. Operator mutates token to 'tok_visa_valid' and retries.
expectedRoute: StartEvent_OrderReceived -> Task_ValidateAndCheckStock -> Gateway_StockAvailability -> Task_DetermineOrderPriority -> Task_ProcessPaymentGateway [INCIDENT: HTTP 504 Gateway Timeout] -> Operate Diagnostic -> Variable paymentToken mutated to 'tok_visa_valid' -> Retry Job in Operate -> Resume -> EndEvent_Fulfilled
